name: rsvp-speed-reader
description: RSVP Speed Reader - Chrome Extension and PWA

scripts.build:extension: npm run build:shared && cp packages/shared/dist/*.js packages/extension/lib/shared/
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && cp packages/shared/dist/*.js packages/web/js/shared/
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && cd cloudflare-worker && ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler pages deploy ../packages/web --project-name=rsvp-reader
